places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Elmira recovers at Dr. Arandel's house, learns Dee was hanged and buried on Boot Hill, rebuffs July's visit, then leaves with Zwey.

places.raw_name: camped a few miles from town
places.name: Elmira and Zwey's camp east of Ogallala
places.note: First night on the road east; Elmira lies awake unafraid while Zwey worries about warnings of Sioux.
places.location_hint: a few miles east of Ogallala on the open plains, on the road toward St. Louis

places.name: St. Louis
places.note: Elmira picks it as a destination simply to get away; Zwey doesn't know the way.

places.name: Santa Fe
places.note: Luke has gone there after hiring on with traders.

places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: July wept with relief behind Clara's saddle shed on learning Elmira lived; he offers to bring the baby in from there.
places.location_hint: on the Platte about twenty miles from Ogallala, Nebraska

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Elmira half remembers July and her former life there.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Zwey says they saw no Indians all the way from there; Elmira feared them the whole trail.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Elmira's fear of Indians lasted until she reached it.

groups.label: Elmira and Big Zwey
groups.at: Elmira and Zwey's camp east of Ogallala
groups.hint: a few miles east of Ogallala, heading east toward St. Louis by wagon

groups.label: July Johnson
groups.hint: rode off from the doctor's house; staying near Ogallala and Clara's ranch
